title: Ship's Cat
description:
You are the ship's cat, responsible for pest control on the world first nuclear powered passenger ship. Move through the ship exploring the passenger and crew areas, gaining new powers as you progress.

 

The game is an action adventure that is easy to play. It has a linear story as seen from the cat's point of view. There is some humour, a fair bit of mystery, and a small amount of scariness and horror.
description_short: As the chief anti-rodent specialist aboard a passenger ship you must rid the ship of mice. Explore the ship, eat the mice and stop them over running the ship.
